purpose: Machine-optimized implementation contract for integrating TypeSafe AI Jev as a bounded semantic-decision layer.
design_invariant: Application code owns workflow authority, policy, side effects, persistence, authorization, deterministic validation, thresholds, and escalation. TypeSafe supplies narrow typed semantic judgments only.

sources.access_note: Direct docs.typesafe.ai page retrieval was unavailable in this session; API/SDK details were cross-verified against current official SDK source. Re-check live docs before future implementation.

request_shape.state: JSON-compatible structured or unstructured application state
request_shape.questions: mapping from application question keys to typed question definitions

rules: do not add a second model-confidence concept
near 0.5 means uncertain binary judgment, not medium intensity
use one Noul per label for independent multi-label classification

choice.use_when: exactly one answer must be selected from a known finite candidate set
rules: include other/none/no_match when candidates may be incomplete
never use to invent arbitrary identifiers
revalidate selected candidate locally before action

response.score: expected numeric position over ordered levels

rules: criteria must be ordered and behaviorally distinct
split independent dimensions into separate Scores
for ranking score candidates consistently then sort in code

avoid: hidden meaning only in question id

batching.rule: Batch independent questions that share state in one System One request.
batching.speculative_branches: Allowed when each question states its premise explicitly and application code ignores unused branch answers.

state_design.preferred_form: named JSON object fields preserving identity, relationships, policy, and provenance

components.name: StateProjector
components.responsibility: select, normalize, redact, and provenance-tag model state

components.name: TypeSafeDecisionClient
components.responsibility: official SDK call, retries, response normalization; no business thresholds

components.name: DecisionReceiptStore
components.responsibility: optional auditable request hash, model answers, policy outcome, provenance; no API key

components.name: SemanticEvalHarness
components.responsibility: shadow comparison, calibration, accuracy, consequence and stability measurements

feature_patterns.authority_rule: selected id must still pass deterministic allowlist/permission/model-policy checks
feature_patterns.fallback: existing deterministic route or reasoning/human escalation

questions: Does this input have multiple plausible behavioral interpretations?
Does resolution require a product/policy/user decision absent from state?
feature_patterns.output: probabilities used to decide ask-user/escalation policy

feature_patterns.rule: TypeSafe narrows context; it does not substitute for source evidence.
use exact deterministic checks instead when exact verification is possible
compose dimensions in application code with explicit formula/policy
coarse category first, then branch-specific Choice; useful for large taxonomies/high-cardinality sets
Jev handles narrow fast judgments; low-confidence/high-consequence/complex cases escalate to a reasoning model or human; preserve separate receipts

failure_semantics.transport_or_service_failure: apply explicit fallback; never silently treat as positive/approved
failure_semantics.semantic_uncertainty: successful call with diffuse/borderline probabilities; escalate by policy; do not retry identical request merely to seek another answer
failure_semantics.authority_bearing_default: fail closed or fall back to existing authority path

requirements: do not put key in state/logs/receipts/fixtures/client bundles
type safety is not authorization or truth

anti_patterns: let semantic output directly mutate state without policy validation
use one omnibus question for multiple dimensions
omit no-match from incomplete candidate sets
treat confidence as correctness or authorization
implementation_checklist: identify semantic decisions currently handled by brittle heuristics or expensive generative calls
promote guarded automation only from measured evidence
